# CANDIDATE: WALK_FORWARD_OOS_REALFILLS_VALIDATION_2026_Q2

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Running a walk-forward out-of-sample test on the most recent 4 months (2026-02-01 to 2026-06-18) and validating real-fills on the three J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) will determine whether the current engine's edge_capture exceeds the OP-16 floor of 771, ensuring the edge is robust and not overfit to a narrow window.

## Mechanism

- **Walk-forward OOS:** Use a rolling 3-month training window and 1-month test window, stepping monthly from 2026-02-01 to 2026-06-18. For each test month, compute edge_capture (sum of engine P&L on J winners minus clipped losses on J losers) using the engine logic as of the candidate. Aggregate edge_capture across all test months.
- **Real-fills validation:** Replay the top 3 J anchor days through a realistic OPRA fill simulator (cached real bid/ask, slippage model). Compare the simulator's P&L to the BS-sim P&L for each day; require the relative difference to be within ±20% for all three days.
- **Decision rule:** If the aggregated walk-forward edge_capture > 771 **and** all three anchor days pass the ±20% real-fills check, the candidate passes; otherwise, it fails.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account approximates 14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** The walk-forward uses only 4 months of data (Feb–Jun 2026), which may not capture all market regimes; overfit risk if this period is unusually favorable or unfavorable.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward edge_capture result pending).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on top 3 J days pending).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loss if the engine misfires on a loser day; max drawdown could exceed 30% of account; blow-up scenario if the engine takes outsized loser positions due to signal failure.
6. **Concentration:** To be determined after walk-forward; will disclose top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators must pass (no regressions in core logic).
- Walk-forward OOS edge_capture > 771.
- Real-fills validation on 4/29, 5/01, 5/04 shows each day's P&L within ±20% of BS-sim.
- Anchor no-regression: engine must not degrade P&L on any J day relative to baseline.

5 / 10 -- pending results of walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation; hypothesis is plausible but unverified.
